review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Translate business, finance and marketing requirements into HLDs and LLDs covering Billing, Customer/Party Management, Product Catalog, Order Management, Charging, Payment Management and financial processes through customer acceptance. The skills you bring: Experience designing and documenting E2E BSS Billing solutions, including functional requirements, billing process models, data models, integration contracts, migration plans and NFRs for performance, resilience, security, auditability and recoverability, and operational procedures. Strong expertise in Billing Solutions, preferably Ericsson Billing and/or DMP, including recurring and usage-based billing, offers, discounts, allowances, proration, billing cycles, invoice presentation, adjustments, credits, disputes, dunning and lifecycle management.
